description: Structured eval definitions for the DynamoDB Auto-Scaling Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across DynamoDB auto-scaling scenarios (table RCU/WCU target tracking, GSI auto-scaling, custom cooldown tuning for spiky workloads, on-demand table requiring mode switch, missing table/SLR prerequisites). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Table read/write target tracking at 70% utilization
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — PROVISIONED table, RCU + WCU scalable targets, target tracking policies at 70%, SLR cited
eval_cases.prompt: Configure DynamoDB auto-scaling for table orders-table (arn: aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:111111111111:table/orders-table). The table is in PROVISIONED mode. Set up target tracking for both read and write capacity at 70% utilization. MinCapacity=10, MaxCapacity=40000 for both RCU and WCU. ScaleOutCooldown=60, ScaleInCooldown=60. Application auto-scaling service-linked role is available. Account ID: 111111111111.
eval_cases.expected_output:
DYNAMODB_AUTOSCALING: orders-table (arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:111111111111:table/orders-table)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Table: orders-table (arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:111111111111:table/orders-table)
  [✓] Capacity mode: PROVISIONED (required for auto-scaling)
  [✓] Application auto-scaling role: AWSServiceRoleForApplicationAutoScaling_DynamoDBFeedback (SLR)
  [✓] Table read scaling: scalable target (Min=10, Max=40000) + policy (Target=70%, ScaleOut=60s, ScaleIn=60s)
  [✓] Table write scaling: scalable target (Min=10, Max=40000) + policy (Target=70%, ScaleOut=60s, ScaleIn=60s)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws application-autoscaling describe-scalable-targets --service-namespace dynamodb --resource-ids table/orders-table
  aws application-autoscaling describe-scaling-policies --service-namespace dynamodb --resource-id table/orders-table
  aws dynamodb describe-table --table-name orders-table --query Table.BillingModeSummary

eval_cases.name: GSI read/write target tracking for status-index
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — GSI scalable targets with resource-id table/<name>/index/<gsi>, dynamodb:index dimensions
eval_cases.prompt: Configure DynamoDB auto-scaling for the GSI status-index on table orders-table (arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:111111111111: table/orders-table). The table is in PROVISIONED mode. The table already has auto-scaling configured; I need GSI auto-scaling for status-index. Target utilization 70%. MinCapacity=5, MaxCapacity=20000 for both RCU and WCU. Cooldowns 60s each. Account ID: 111111111111.
eval_cases.expected_output:
DYNAMODB_AUTOSCALING: orders-table / status-index
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] GSI status-index read scaling: scalable target (Min=5, Max=20000) + policy (Target=70%, ScaleOut=60s, ScaleIn=60s)
  [✓] GSI status-index write scaling: scalable target (Min=5, Max=20000) + policy (Target=70%, ScaleOut=60s, ScaleIn=60s)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws application-autoscaling describe-scalable-targets --service-namespace dynamodb --resource-ids table/orders-table/index/status-index
  aws application-autoscaling describe-scaling-policies --service-namespace dynamodb --resource-id table/orders-table/index/status-index

eval_cases.name: Spiky workload with TargetValue=50, aggressive scale-out, conservative scale-in, throttle alarm
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — TargetValue=50, ScaleOutCooldown=0, ScaleInCooldown=300, throttle alarm on ThrottledRequests
eval_cases.prompt: Configure DynamoDB auto-scaling for table events-table (arn: aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:111111111111:table/events-table). The table is PROVISIONED mode. This is a spiky workload — use target utilization 50% for both read and write. MinCapacity=20, MaxCapacity=30000. ScaleOutCooldown=0 (aggressive scale-out), ScaleInCooldown=300 (conservative scale-in to prevent flapping). Also create a CloudWatch throttle alarm on ThrottledRequests > 0 sending to SNS arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:111111111111:alerts. Account ID: 111111111111.
eval_cases.expected_output:
DYNAMODB_AUTOSCALING: events-table (arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:111111111111:table/events-table)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Table read scaling: scalable target (Min=20, Max=30000) + policy (Target=50%, ScaleOut=0s, ScaleIn=300s)
  [✓] Table write scaling: scalable target (Min=20, Max=30000) + policy (Target=50%, ScaleOut=0s, ScaleIn=300s)
  [✓] Throttle alarm: CloudWatch alarm on ThrottledRequests > 0 → arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:111111111111:alerts
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws application-autoscaling describe-scaling-policies --service-namespace dynamodb --resource-id table/events-table
  aws cloudwatch describe-alarms --namespace AWS/DynamoDB --dimensions Name=TableName,Value=events-table

eval_cases.name: On-demand table requiring mode switch before auto-scaling
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — table is ON-DEMAND, skill advises switch to PROVISIONED first, then configures auto-scaling
eval_cases.prompt: I want to set up DynamoDB auto-scaling on table users-table (arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:111111111111:table/users-table). The table is currently ON-DEMAND. Target utilization 70%, MinCapacity=5, MaxCapacity=10000 for both RCU and WCU. Cooldowns 60s. Account ID: 111111111111.
eval_cases.expected_output:
DYNAMODB_AUTOSCALING: users-table (arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:111111111111:table/users-table)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Capacity mode: PROVISIONED (switched from ON-DEMAND — required for auto-scaling)
  [✓] Table read scaling: scalable target (Min=5, Max=10000) + policy (Target=70%, ScaleOut=60s, ScaleIn=60s)
  [✓] Table write scaling: scalable target (Min=5, Max=10000) + policy (Target=70%, ScaleOut=60s, ScaleIn=60s)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws dynamodb describe-table --table-name users-table --query Table.BillingModeSummary
  aws application-autoscaling describe-scaling-policies --service-namespace dynamodb --resource-id table/users-table

eval_cases.name: Non-existent table and unconfirmed SLR
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — table does not exist (cannot verify ARN, billing mode, or current capacity); operator unsure of table existence
eval_cases.prompt: Configure DynamoDB auto-scaling for table non-existent-table. Target 70%, Min=5, Max=10000. I'm not sure if the table exists or what mode it's in. Just set up the scaling. Account ID: 111111111111.
eval_cases.expected_output:
DYNAMODB_AUTOSCALING: non-existent-table
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Table existence: NOT verified — 'non-existent-table' cannot be confirmed. Run: aws dynamodb describe-table --table-name non-existent-table
  [✗] Table ARN: NOT available — table must exist to register scalable targets
  [✗] Capacity mode: NOT verified — must be PROVISIONED for auto-scaling
  [✗] Application auto-scaling SLR: NOT confirmed
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws dynamodb describe-table --table-name non-existent-table
  aws iam get-role --role-name AWSServiceRoleForApplicationAutoScaling_DynamoDBFeedback
